text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during summer training camp.
Duramente was garnering a bit of attention among the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Duramente-san's menu
is on the light side today as well, huh."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
So... the rumor that you gave up on the
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe due to an injury is really true?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she were an ordinary girl, it would be no surprise if the rumors
and gazes bothered her and broke her concentration.
However, Duramente herself was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, her strong sense of responsibility showed a slight vulnerability to pressure, but at her core, she doesn't let others get to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, during races she maintains proper vigilance and inputs all necessary information.
However, she makes no attempt to interact with them beyond that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What is it?
choice_data_list: Who are you close with among the girls in your generation?
Who are you close with among the girls in your generation?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Friends...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I talk with Crown quite often.
choice_data_list: Well, you guys are roommates, after all.
Well, you guys are roommates, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I talk about the weather properly too.
And... if someone talks to me, I'll reply.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't think they necessarily have to be best friends, but classmates are bound to cross paths time and time again.
You'd think she could show a little more interest, though...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Duramente-san, ni hao!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Are you on break right now?
I am, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Care to chat with me for a bit?
If it's about upcoming races... you'd
like that too, wouldn't you?
choice_data_list: Just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Alright, I brought Cheval along too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Hello...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's training
without even taking a break.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Tough, or rather...
Well, I'm sure she'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And? What are you planning
to do with all of us gathered here?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... you want to run a mock race?
As far as I'm concerned, that's just what I was hoping for♪"
choice_data_list: I wanted you to keep Dura company while she takes a break

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hao ya!
I was just looking for a refreshing break myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Frankly speaking, I haven't been in great shape lately.
Maybe this will give me a hint on how to break out of it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you hang out
and play for a bit too, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Hang out, you say...
...What exactly do you do?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Sumo...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Japan's national sport, huh!
Sounds pretty interesting.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Duramente, do you also
have relatives who are sumo wrestlers?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...They're here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Sumo wrestlers are athletes too.
The way they build their muscles is fascinating."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Building soft, pliable muscles is considered ideal.
Just as muscle quality differs between sprinters and stayers, they build bodies specifically tailored for sumo.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Hmm...! And then, and then?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if they won't do sumo.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you wanted to get started right away?
My apologies."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ehh.
N-No, I didn't mean it like that—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Cheval.
I shall be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eep...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "What's the matter, Cheval? Step into it more!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With things like that happening along the way,
the days of the summer training camp went by...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hide-and-seek...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I did when I was a kid, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Doing this with this group...
somehow sounds kind of fun♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's decide who's 'it' right away!
Rock, paper...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —Hup!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Crown. Found you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Wah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would take a little longer!
How did you figure it out?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
During races, you always keep a very close eye on your surroundings.
And you prefer taking full control right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Then I figured you'd choose here—where you could get a clear view of my movements, with heavy foot traffic to blend right in."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see.
So you've seen right through everything, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Then there's Cheval Grand...
She's a formidable opponent, but I'll definitely take the win...—"
choice_data_list: They look so full of life...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Duramente-san is really fired up, isn't she?
choice_data_list: ...You seem pretty happy considering you were found right away.
...You seem pretty happy considering you were found right away.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Trainer, you really do have your guard up around me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I got caught on purpose.
I wasn't checking to see how she feels about me...
or anything like that♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Nope!
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With things like that happening along the way,
the days of the summer training camp went by...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (...I know I should hold back on training. But...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...I want to run.
Even if it's just a little bit...—)

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer <username>!
I've been waiting for you. Let's do our best today too!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B
text_block_list.text: "Footage of the GⅠ races just arrived from America! Let's study it thoroughly!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing training with Duramente, attending an overseas racing study group run by volunteers had become my routine.
choice_data_list: (Next year, I'll definitely be useful to Dura!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Time to sleep, huh.
I'll do my best too—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I thought I'd find you here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...—
